description: No clean concept; a diffuse direction. Only weak tendencies: it fires more in the early-to-middle game (about ply 2-16), when the opponent owns the bottom-centre cell (row 0, column 3) and I have few or no stones in column 3, and when the opponent's stones are not on the bottom of columns 5-6. Almost any single stone change shifts it, so these cues are unreliable.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to its max or to zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.01 (7 positions).
notes: 4 of 8 score calls used (one wasted). Best p2 additive cue score: dev F1 0.207 (P 0.16, R 0.30), AUROC 0.68, simulation share 0.03. Simpler rules (their (0,3); ply<=16 and they outnumber me in col 3) score F1 0.14-0.19. Minimal pairs show graded, column- and context-dependent shifts of 0.2-0.7 per stone and no discrete trigger. Activation is board-based (move order barely matters) and flips between consecutive plies. Synthesis reached 1.874, below dev max 2.353. Possibly a random control direction.
